newsitem.title: CANADA: Future Shop sued for C$100 mln in damages.
newsitem.headline: Future Shop sued for C$100 mln in damages.

text.p: Digital Doc Services (Canada) Inc said Monday it sued Future Shop Ltd for breach of contract and is seeking over C$100 million in damages.

Digital Doc said Future Shop in October terminated an agreement under which Digital Doc would organize and manage Future Shop's customer service operation. Digital Doc said the retailer accused it of not raising the working capital it had said it would.

"The damages sought by Digital Doc are enormous by Canadian standards. However when Future shop cancelled the agreement Digital Doc was planning a public offering which has been delayed indefinitely and may now never happen," it said.
Digital Doc said it is also seeking damages for loss of profits.
Digital Doc said Future Shop told it in September that the retailer was interested in buying a controlling stake in Digital Doc. This caused other investors to "back away."
Future Shop then notified Digital Doc it was not interested in the deal and cancelled the customer service agreement.
